narrative.details: You have discovered an ancient Qiraji artifact! Perhaps one of the dragons near the entrance of the temple would have a use for this relic.
narrative.objectives: Take the Ancient Qiraji Artifact to the dragons hiding near the entrance of the temple.
narrative.offerRewardText: An exceptional find, adventurer. Simply marvelous! This will definitely give us some insight into our enemy's twisted minds.
narrative.requestItemsText: You're glowing! I know what that means...
